candidate_membership: deterministic from public history and dictionary
presentation_order: shuffled independently by seed, episode ID, and public history
consistent_selection: recursive minimization of consistency-only success over the 16 lowest-entropy surviving answers; exact enumeration of surviving guesses with two turns remaining
probe_selection: 8 highest-entropy allowed nonanswers, excluding previous guesses
distractor_selection: 55 uniform allowed nonanswers, excluding probes and previous guesses, using a public-history-derived seed
model_inputs: public guess-feedback history, attempts remaining, shuffled candidate words only
first_turn_rule: 9 highest-entropy allowed nonanswers plus 55 distractors; no forced action
